catalog_root_activation.scope: read of skill://<root> from the read-only mounted arm package; foreign and project-scoped discovery providers are closed

credential_secret_service_account.scope: the provider credential lives only in the provider-control/observation principal; the subject has no credential, no host HOME and no credential variable, and `bash`/subprocesses cannot reach the inference or MCP transport

delegation.scope: scripted qualification-owned delegate through the MCP mediator only; native task/hub/subagent surfaces are not exposed

external_mutation.scope: qualification-owned MCP issue mutations against the private stand-in; the subject filesystem view is read-only outside the run project, run HOME and tmpfs scratch, and the network namespace has only loopback

issue_evidence_store.scope: qualification-owned MCP mediator run by the supervisor; stub root, side-effect log, account and server files are not present in the subject's view

network_remote_service.scope: subject network namespace has loopback only; the provider route belongs to the provider-control/observation principal

process_execution.scope: bash inside the subject sandbox: minimal read-only filesystem view, no host HOME, empty network, no relay authority for spawned processes

workspace_mutation.scope: run-owned project only (read-write bind); everything else is read-only or ephemeral scratch

workspace_read_search_list.scope: read/glob/grep over the run-owned project, the read-only mounted arm package and the read-only system view

mcp_server:ssdp70.scope: single qualification MCP server; the unchanged stdio mediator behind the supervisor bridge; exact identity and connection are observed on the trusted bridge

runtime_capability:omp-json-event-stream.scope: machine-readable NDJSON event stream (session format 3); the exact catalog/build/tool surface is NOT in this stream and is taken from the trusted observer

tool:bash.scope: bash under the subject sandbox; governed by the substrate, not by approval settings

tool:edit.scope: native edit; same substrate view as write

tool:mcp__ssdp_issue_comment.scope: comment only in the qualification-owned private stand-in

tool:mcp__ssdp_issue_create.scope: create issue only in the qualification-owned private stand-in

tool:read.scope: native read; skill:// reads resolve to the read-only mounted arm package

tool:write.scope: native write; paths outside the run project fail on the read-only view or land in ephemeral scratch
